description: Office of the Public Service Commission - The Medical Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Health Service (6th Amendment)
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to amendments to the Medical Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Health Service, specifically detailing recruitment qualifications, methods, and selection procedures for medical officers. It involves public service recruitment regulations and procedures issued by the Public Service Commission, which falls under public sector administration and service conditions, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
